title.zh: 【Visa Direct 将稳定币预注资功能转为商业部署】
title.en: 【Visa Direct 将稳定币预注资功能转为商业部署】

current_state.zh: Visa has moved Visa Direct's stablecoin pre-funding capability from pilot to commercial deployment for cross-border payments, with Inyo Global as the first platform integrator letting eligible clients pre-fund using USDC near real time instead of traditional funding windows.
current_state.en: Visa has moved Visa Direct's stablecoin pre-funding capability from pilot to commercial deployment for cross-border payments, with Inyo Global as the first platform integrator letting eligible clients pre-fund using USDC near real time instead of traditional funding windows.
